name: Gravedigger's Spade
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 221
Aura moderate conjuration and evocation CL 8th
Slot none; Price 12,150 gp; Weight 4 lbs.
Description
The sturdy, well-polished oaken shaft and the sharp blade attached to its tip allow this magical staff to be used as a masterwork shovel when not employed in spellcasting.
Expeditious excavation (1 charge)
Create pit (2 charges)
Spiked pit (5 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, expeditious excavationAPG, create pitAPG, spiked pitAPG; Cost 6,100 gp
